wholePhysicalScope: Named 41-corner roofed cell-block footprint, the mapped north entrance and front stone boundary, east return, secondary walls, and Coote Road steps.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the perimeter, gate, enclosed yard and gabled wings. Street and close views add sandstone courses, joined casements, bars, hardware and stair detail.
limitations: The mapped building shell and remaining enclosure are represented at medium fidelity. Roof ridge profiles, room wings, rear openings, changing wall levels, foundations and gate hardware follow the written survey and are estimated where exterior photographs provide no coverage.
The main gate follows the public-domain original. The plaque and crossed keys retain their historic position and scale, with simplified lettering and ironwork.
The source terrain is preserved. The alignment of the modeled stair threshold and courtyard floors with historic survey levels is approximate.
